name: truly-new
about: A name the story hasn't said before: "you never mentioned" is fair, and nothing is invented about it.

card.name: Buffy
card.description: Buffy Summers, twenty, lives with her sister Dawn.

history.content: "That was my cousin. You'd like Marisol." He shrugs.

reply: "Marisol. You never mentioned a Marisol." Buffy tilted her head. "Okay. New file."
